entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin planeswalker and master artificer from Fiora who lost the use of his legs in an accident and later lost his spark in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: Daretti's apprentice, blamed for his master's apparent death.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A plane of cunning and shadowy games, home of Daretti.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: A city on Fiora with a Lowlands where Daretti grew up and a High City with an Academy.

entities.name: Academy of Paliano
entities.description: The Paliano academy of artificers where Daretti became a tenured professor; it was disbanded through his schemes.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: Crowned queen of Paliano after Brago was assassinated.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: A ruler of Paliano who was assassinated by the planeswalker Kaya.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who assassinated Brago.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A goblin and former dungeon warden of the palace prison who led disenfranchised goblins with Daretti.

entities.name: Fimarell
entities.description: A professor who had plagiarized Daretti's designs and was killed by him.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which Daretti lost his spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Daretti fought Phyrexian warriors.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane on which Daretti was stranded after losing his spark.

entities.name: Goblin Rocketeers
entities.description: A goblin racing team in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, sponsored by Daretti.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: An interplanar race in which Daretti sponsored the Goblin Rocketeers in its second running.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A character captured by saurids and imprisoned with Daretti; she located an Omenpath to Amonkhet.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who rescued Daretti and Loot and drove his car away from the saurid village.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A character who helped rescue Daretti and Loot and patched up the car.

entities.name: Saurids
entities.description: Raiders who laid a trap on the course and imprisoned Daretti and Loot.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: A character who attempted a coup of the Consulate.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: The region of the third leg of the Grand Prix where saurids laid a trap.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane reached by an Omenpath during the escape.

entities.name: Cogchair
entities.description: Daretti's cogwork wheelchair with cogwheels and manipulator arms usable for artifice, rough terrain or combat.

events.summary: One of Daretti's cogwork constructs explodes, apparently killing him; the blast ignites his spark and he planeswalks away, losing the use of his legs.
events.quote: In reality, the explosion ignited Daretti's Planeswalker's spark , and he planeswalked to relative safety.

events.summary: Muzzio is blamed for Daretti's apparent death, letting the Academy remove two troublesome members.
events.quote: Daretti's apprentice Muzzio was blamed for the artificer's death

events.summary: After Marchesa is crowned, Daretti allies with disenfranchised goblins under Grenzo to take revenge, and his schemes lead to the Academy's disbanding.
events.quote: His schemes were responsible for the disbanding of the Academy

events.summary: Daretti and Grenzo raid Professor Fimarell's home; Daretti discovers the plagiarism and kills Fimarell.
events.quote: After killing Fimarell, he and the other goblins turned their attention to the former academy members

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Daretti fights and defeats many Phyrexian warriors.
events.quote: Daretti fought and defeated many Phyrexian warriors, considering their artifice inelegant.

events.summary: In the Desparkening Daretti loses his spark and is stranded on Avishkar.
events.quote: In the Desparkening , Daretti lost his spark and was stranded on Avishkar .

events.summary: Daretti bankrolls the Goblin Rocketeers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find new interplanar travel.
events.quote: He bankrolled the team in the hopes of discovering a new means of interplanar travel after the loss of his spark.

events.summary: The Rocketeers use Daretti as a decoy; he is taken to a saurid village and imprisoned with Loot to be sacrificed.
events.quote: He was taken to a saurid village and imprisoned alongside Loot to be offered as a sacrifice.

events.summary: Chandra and Pia Nalaar rescue Daretti and Loot; Daretti patches his car and Chandra drives it away.
events.quote: Daretti quickly patched together his car, and Chandra drove it away from the village.

events.summary: The four escape through an Omenpath to Amonkhet and crash-land, then repair the car.
events.quote: The four barely managed to escape through an Omenpath to Amonkhet located by Loot

events.summary: Daretti backs Chandra as she fights insurgents in Mohar Varma's attempted Consulate coup, which is prevented.
events.quote: Ultimately, the coup was prevented, although the Rocketeers did not place in the race.

relations.quote: Daretti's apprentice Muzzio was blamed for the artificer's death
after Brago had been assassinated by the planeswalker Kaya

relations.note: allied with goblins under Grenzo's leadership
relations.quote: Daretti allied with several disenfranchised goblins under the leadership of Grenzo

relations.note: killed the professor after discovering plagiarism

relations.quote: He became the adoptive benefactor and unofficial co-captain of the Goblin Rocketeers

relations.note: rescued him and fought alongside him
relations.quote: Daretti backed Chandra up as she fought against the insurgents.
